commands: echo "RUN_ID=${GITHUB_RUN_ID:-<unset>} ATTEMPT=${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT:-<unset>} ACTIONS=${GITHUB_ACTIONS:-<unset>}"; echo "---headoid---"; gh pr view 1958 --json headRefOid,baseRefOid,headRefName --jq '.headRefOid + " base=" + .baseRefOid + " headref=" + .headRefName'

mkdir -p .prflow/tmp; rm -f .prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before .prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-disabled 2>/dev/null; git status --porcelain -z > .prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before && git hash-object .prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before

for m in review-contract implement-contract workpad-cli; do
echo "== $m =="
git show 3f193f668f9293d22ce72d7ac21dc4339059124c:lib/test/modules/$m.sh | grep -c "assert_eq"
done

for l in "#693 scanner" "#338(T6)" "#1264 placeholder" "#1618 skill-body" "#1897"; do
  c=$(git show 3f193f668f9293d22ce72d7ac21dc4339059124c:lib/test/run.sh | grep -c "$l")
  echo "run.sh occurrences of [$l]: $c"
done

p=.prflow/tmp/review/pr-1958/local-run/diff.patch
echo "=== added assert_eq per module file ==="
awk '/^diff --git/{f=$0} /^\+.*assert_eq /{print f}' "$p" | sort | uniq -c
echo "=== removed assert_eq total (run.sh) ==="
grep -c '^-.*assert_eq ' "$p"
echo "=== added assert_eq in review-contract.sh region ==="
awk '/^\+\+\+ b\/lib\/test\/modules\/review-contract.sh/{inr=1} /^\+\+\+ b\/lib\/test\/modules\/workpad-cli.sh/{inr=0} inr && /^\+.*assert_eq /' "$p" | wc -l
for m in implement-contract review-contract workpad-cli; do echo "=== $m ==="; lib/test/run-module.sh $m 2>&1 | tail -4; done

git worktree add -q /tmp/pr1958 3f193f668f9293d22ce72d7ac21dc4339059124c 2>&1; cd /tmp/pr1958 && for m in implement-contract review-contract workpad-cli; do echo "=== $m ==="; lib/test/run-module.sh $m 2>&1 | tail -3; done

for m in review-contract implement-contract workpad-cli; do
echo "== $m =="
git show 3f193f668f9293d22ce72d7ac21dc4339059124c:lib/test/modules/$m.sh | grep -cE "^[[:space:]]*assert_eq|devflow_module_pin"
done
for f in review-contract implement-contract workpad-cli; do echo "===== $f.inventory.md ====="; git show 3f193f668f9293d22ce72d7ac21dc4339059124c:lib/test/modules/$f.inventory.md; echo; done
